decision: Select (GO) or reject (NO-GO) Qwen3.5-2B as the natural-farming ladder champion replacement. Default on any tie or inconclusive result: keep the distilled 0.6B champion and publish the negative result.

adaptation_landed.metric: adapted Qwen3.5 minus stock Qwen3.5 on the frozen 210-item ladder (paired items)
adaptation_landed.rationale: F8 0.6B lift was +44.3pp and #232 1.7B lift +13.8pp (p=9e-06); +3pp is the minimum unambiguous adaptation signal above the ~0.5pp 4-bit run-to-run noise floor.

deployability_proxy.metric: NF4 4-bit load of adapted Qwen3.5 vs its HF precision on the same ladder
deployability_proxy.rationale: Cactus CQ leg is BLOCKED (G1/G2); an NF4 proxy drop larger than 3pp means the adapted weights are unlikely to survive INT4 deployment even if R1/R2 unblock.

freeform_guard.metric: two falsifiable local signals on the fixed first-30 eval_freeform/dev.jsonl rows (sealed test.jsonl never touched): (1) non-degenerate rate = fraction of answers neither empty nor 4-gram-repetition-collapsed; (2) mean teacher-forced per-token NLL of the dev reference_answer given the question
freeform_guard.threshold: (1) adapted non-degenerate rate regresses vs stock by <= 5pp with zero empty/refusal-cluster failures; (2) adapted mean ref-NLL exceeds stock by <= 5% relative
freeform_guard.rationale: Mechanical degeneracy plus reference-likelihood regression both falsify: a collapsed model fails (1) and a factually degraded model fails (2). The repo rubric-LLM judge (score_rubric.py, OpenRouter backend) is deliberately excluded: backend-dependent grading would make the gate unreproducible offline. Honestly labelled as a guard against degradation, not a positive instruction-following proof.

latency_memory.metric: peak training VRAM; mean per-item ladder decode latency vs the 0.6B champion
latency_memory.threshold: peak VRAM <= 11.5 GiB on the 12 GiB card; mean latency <= 3x the 0.6B champion mean
latency_memory.rationale: A phone-track candidate that cannot train or serve within the project's hardware budget is not selectable.

quality_go.metric: adapted Qwen3.5 minus distilled 0.6B champion (outputs/merged-model-distill-v2-rationale) on the frozen 210-item ladder, paired
quality_go.rationale: Prior #232: adapted 1.7B scored 182/210 vs F8 183/210 (delta -0.5pp, p=1.00) and was correctly judged 'larger alone is not better'. Qwen3.5 must clear a paired-significant margin, not just match.

note: Cactus on-device leg is BLOCKED per G1/G2; any GO from this gate is HF-runtime-only (research result), explicitly not a deployed phone deliverable. G4/G5 wait on upstream R1/R2.
